description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'GameLoop' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Core gameplay loop configuration — match settings, level pacing, difficulty curves, energy/cooldown gates, retry/continue economy. Use for tuning the moment-to-moment gameplay; not for content (use Item, Character, Collection) and not for meta-progression (use Season).

AttackBonusDrop.description: A single independent probabilistic drop on attack.

Chance.description: Trigger probability (0.0..1.0). 0.05 = 5%. Drops are rolled independently and not normalized; the sum of Chance across the list may exceed 1.0.

RequiredOutcome.description: Filter by attack outcome. null = triggers on any outcome. Typically restricted to AttackOutcome.Hit so Blocked does not grant the bonus.

Reward.description: Drop payload (typically Grant.Standard.EventTokens). ScaleWithRollMultiplier controls roll-multiplier scaling.

x-enum-descriptions: Attack succeeded: target building is damaged (level -1, IsDamaged = true); attacker receives the full BaseAttackReward.
Attack blocked by a shield: one victim shield is consumed; the attacker's reward (BaseAttackReward) is multiplied by ProceduralEconomyConfig.AttackBlockedRewardFactor.

BoardBotConfig.description: Bot opponent simulation config (used when no real attack/raid target is available).

DamagedBuildingChance.description: Probability (0..1) that a generated bot building starts damaged.

RankMultiplierMax.description: Upper bound of the random rank multiplier (>= RankMultiplierMin). Required — must be set (> 0), no default.

RankMultiplierMin.description: Lower bound of the random rank multiplier applied to the attacker's BoardRank. Required — must be set (> 0), no default.

RankOffsetMax.description: Upper bound (inclusive) of the random flat rank offset (>= RankOffsetMin).

RankOffsetMin.description: Lower bound of the random flat rank offset added on top of the multiplied rank.

ShieldChance.description: Probability (0..1) that a generated bot already holds a shield.

StageLevelSpread.description: Half-width of the window the bot's stage level is drawn from: a random level in [attackerStage - spread, attackerStage + spread], clamped at board 1. Spread 2 for a player on board 3 yields targets from board 1 to 5. 0 = the bot always sits on the attacker's board. Visual only (target buildings + background); attack rewards always use the attacker's stage.

BoardBotRaidConfig.description: Incoming bot attacks: bots attack the player while they are offline, costing real resources. Materialized lazily when the player opens the board, never in a background job.

AttackWeight.description: Weight of the ATTACK outcome (knocks a building level down). If both weights are 0, ATTACK is used.

Chance.description: Probability (0..1) that a bot actually attacked during an elapsed interval. 0 = platform default (0.5); 1 = always.

Enabled.description: Master switch. Default false: the mechanic takes resources away from the player, so it is enabled deliberately.

IntervalSeconds.description: Real time in seconds that must pass to give bots ONE attempt to attack. <= 0 disables the mechanic (a typo here would otherwise mean an unbounded number of attempts).

MaxPerCatchUp.description: Cap on attacks applied within a single player visit. It also clamps how far back the anchor is rewound (now - IntervalSeconds * MaxPerCatchUp), so a long absence cannot wipe the player out on return. 0 = platform default (3).

MinBoardStageLevel.description: The board level from which the player becomes attackable by bots (newbie protection). 0 = platform default (2).

RaidLossMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the player's loss relative to BaseRaidReward of their own stage (the same quantity a real raid uses for the victim's loss). <= 0 = platform default 1.0.

RaidWeight.description: Weight of the RAID outcome (steals resources).

BoardDiceConfig.description: Dice roll config. Step = sum of Count dice each rolling 1..Sides.

Count.description: Number of dice rolled per step. Required — must be set (> 0), no default.

Sides.description: Number of faces per die (each die rolls 1..Sides). Required — must be set (> 0), no default.

BoardLoopDefinition.description: Global game board config. Defines energy and shield currencies, allowed roll multipliers, tile templates and stages. Read by clients via GetBoardDefinition / GetBoardDefinitionForLevel.

AllowedRollMultipliers.description: Ordered list of allowed roll-multiplier values (e.g. [1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100]). The server normalizes any requested multiplier down to the nearest value in this list that does not exceed the player's dice balance. Required — must be configured per title (no default).

BoardTemplatesByID.description: Dictionary of tile-ring templates. Key is an arbitrary template ID. A stage references one via BoardStageDefinition.BoardTemplateID; different stages may share templates.

BotRaids.description: Incoming bot attacks simulated while the player was away. null = disabled.

Bots.description: Bot opponent simulation config (shield/damage chances, rank range). Required — configured per title (no default).

Dice.description: Dice roll configuration (number of dice and faces). Required — configured per title (no default).

ProceduralEconomy.description: Procedural-economy container: normalized cost matrix, tail growth of the unit price Unit(N), visual-template cycle for endless boards, the scaled-resource allow-list, and attack/raid reward tuning flags.

RaidMode.description: Raid mini-game mode. Fast: client receives the full RaidLayout and plays locally. Sequential: cells are revealed one-by-one via the server.

RollCurrencyID.description: ID of the virtual currency used as energy (dice). Each roll consumes usedMultiplier units. Required — must be configured per title (no default).

ShieldCurrencyID.description: ID of the shield virtual currency. Shields block attacks and are consumed from the victim. Overflow (above BoardStageTemplate.MaxShields) is converted into RollCurrencyID (dice refund). Required when the board uses shields (no default).

SoftCurrencyID.description: ID of the soft currency used for building upgrades. Build cost (Unit(N) * CostMatrix[slot][level]) is charged in this currency. Required — must be configured per title (no default).

StageTemplatesByID.description: Dictionary of stage-economy templates (BaseAttackReward/BaseRaidReward, MaxRollMultiplier, MaxShields, HeistGridBonusConfig, StageOperations, TileLandingMultiplier, EconomyOverride). Key is an arbitrary template ID. Stages must reference one via BoardStageDefinition.StageTemplateID and may optionally override fields via BoardStageDefinition.Override.

StagesByLevel.description: Dictionary of stages (locations) by level. Key is the level number as a string ("1", "2", ...). Lookup falls back to the nearest lower level, or to the minimum available if no lower entry exists.

Targeting.description: Target selection rules for attack and raid. null = previous behaviour: a target is picked from friends with no repeat limit.

BoardStageDefinition.description: Config for a single stage (location/board). Holds only structural stage fields; all economy is taken from BoardLoopDefinition.StageTemplatesByID via StageTemplateID, with optional per-field override via Override.

AssetPaths.description: Asset paths for the stage (key = asset type, value = path). Optional; used by the client to load visual resources.

BoardTemplateID.description: ID of the tile template from BoardLoopDefinition.BoardTemplatesByID that defines this stage's tile ring.

Buildings.description: Inline buildings on the stage (typically 5, SlotIndex 0..4). Each is upgraded independently; level cost = ceil(Unit(N) * CostMatrix[SlotIndex][level]). Middle layer of building resolution: Override.Buildings -> this inline list -> BoardStageTemplate.Buildings (shared template). Empty = inherit from the template.

CostMatrixTemplateID.description: ID of the cost-matrix template from ProceduralEconomyConfig.CostMatrixTemplatesByID. null/empty -> "Universal". Special boards (e.g. 9) point to their own template ("WideSpread").

Name.description: Stage display name (for CMS and debugging).

Override.description: Per-field economy override for this stage. Any non-null field in this container overrides the corresponding template field. Dictionaries StageOperations.OnTileLanding/OnAttack/OnRaid are key-merged (override values win per-key); other fields and OnAttackBonusDrops are replaced whole. null = no overrides, stage uses the template 1:1.

StageTemplateID.description: ID of the economy template from BoardLoopDefinition.StageTemplatesByID. Required. If not found, the server fails with a config error rather than silently substituting defaults.

UnitValue.description: Authored anchor for this board's unit price — the B1-L1 upgrade cost in soft currency. Between anchors Unit(N) is geometrically interpolated; past the last it is extrapolated by tail growth. Bound to this level instance (not the shared template). null = computed from neighbouring anchors.

BoardStageTemplate.description: Stage economy template. Same class is reused both as the canonical entry in BoardLoopDefinition.StageTemplatesByID and as the override container on BoardStageDefinition.Override. All fields are nullable: null means "not set here — look at the template or the hardcoded fallback in the resolver".

BaseAttackReward.description: Base resource bundle for a successful attack (pre-multipliers). Scaled by RollMultiplier, EconomyTuning, EconomyScale (attacker's board) and the value weight of the building being hit (CostMatrix[slot][hitLevel-1]). On AttackOutcome.Blocked it is multiplied by ProceduralEconomyConfig.AttackBlockedRewardFactor (not a hardcoded 0.5). null = no reward.

BaseRaidReward.description: Base victim bank for a raid (pre-multipliers). Two decoupled amounts. Attacker gain (systemic, all branches): BaseRaidReward * RollMultiplier * heistMultiplier * EconomyScale(attacker's board) * Jackpot * tuning, NOT capped by the victim's balance. Victim loss (independent): BaseRaidReward * EconomyScale(victim's board) * (heistMultiplier if ScaleVictimLossWithTier), then clipped to the victim's balance. Stolen != lost. null = no bank.

Buildings.description: Stage buildings (SlotIndex 0..N, per-building MaxLevel). Lets a shared building layout be authored once in the template and reused across stages, with optional per-stage override. Resolve priority (first non-empty wins): BoardStageDefinition.Override.Buildings -> BoardStageDefinition.Buildings (inline) -> this template list. null/empty = not set here, fall through to the next layer.

EconomyOverride.description: Per-stage override of procedural-economy parameters: cost-matrix shape, tail growth, manual EconomyScale, scaled-resource allow-list. Any non-null field overrides the corresponding global default from ProceduralEconomyConfig. null = inherit the global values wholesale.

HeistGridBonusConfig.description: Distribution of bonuses and modes in the Bank Heist raid grid. null = all raids on this stage are classic (no bonuses or jackpot).

MaxRollMultiplier.description: Maximum allowed roll multiplier on this stage. Required — taken strictly from config; the resolver returns a config error if missing (no hardcoded default).

MaxShields.description: Maximum number of shields on the stage. Shields above the cap convert into RollCurrencyID (dice refund). Required — taken strictly from config; config error if missing (no hardcoded default). 0 is allowed = no shields.

StageOperations.description: Full set of resource operations tied to stage events. Resolver merges dictionaries OnTileLanding/OnAttack/OnRaid by key (override wins per-key); scalars OnPassStart/OnBuild/OnStageComplete — override wins whole; list OnAttackBonusDrops — override wins whole.

TileLandingMultiplier.description: Random multiplier applied to Amount values in OnTileLanding rewards. One roll mul in [Min, Max] per landing multiplies every ResourceEntry.Amount and EventTokenOperation.Amount inside the selected operation. Applied BEFORE RollMultiplier and ModifierService. Scope: OnTileLanding only — does NOT affect OnAttack/OnRaid/OnBuild/OnStageComplete/OnPassStart. null = neutral (x 1.0).

BoardTargetingConfig.description: Target selection rules for attack and raid.

AttackCooldownSeconds.description: Seconds before the same player can be picked as an ATTACK target again. The stamp is written when the target is SELECTED, not when the hit lands, so abandoning a pending interaction cannot re-roll for the same friend. Bots are never subject to it. 0 or negative = disabled.

LiveOpponentActiveDays.description: Activity window in days for a random live opponent (the candidate must have entered the game within this many days). 0 = platform default (30). NEGATIVE disables the live-opponent tier entirely, leaving friends and bots. Activity is measured by LastRequestHeaders.RequestTime (last login/session refresh), which is the indexed field.

LiveOpponentPoolCacheSeconds.description: Seconds the live-candidate pool is reused across rolls (shared by all players of the title). 0 = platform default (60). Without it the pool would be read on every attack/raid roll; it does not make targets repeat, since the order is reshuffled per roll.

LiveOpponentPoolSize.description: How many recently active players of the title to keep in the candidate pool. 0 = platform default (200). This is a page size, not a game rule: one target is needed and the pool order is reshuffled per roll.

MaxLiveCandidateReads.description: Cap on how many live-candidate documents may be read within a single roll. 0 = platform default (5). The scan stops at the first suitable candidate and costs one read each; exhausting the budget falls through to a bot.

MaxRecentTargets.description: Cap on BoardLoopState.RecentTargets entries. Required because the keys are other players' ids. 0 = platform default. Setting it below what actually accumulates within the cooldown lets evicted targets become selectable early - the list is trimmed by recency.

RaidCooldownSeconds.description: Same for RAID, as a separate number. Stamps are stored per (player, action) pair, so a raid on a target just picked for an attack is not blocked, and vice versa. 0 or negative = disabled.

VictimImmunitySeconds.description: Seconds a player cannot be picked as a target by STRANGERS after being attacked (victim-side, BoardLoopState.LastAttackedAtUtc). 0 = platform default (3600); negative = disabled. Different from AttackCooldownSeconds, which lives on the attacker and only prevents repeats by the same player. Friends are exempt.

BoardTemplateDefinition.description: Board template — a fixed tile ring shared across stages. Defines tile layout and types independently of stage economy.

Tiles.description: Ordered set of tiles forming the board ring. The element index matches BoardTileDefinition.Index.

BoardTileDefinition.description: Config of a single board tile.

ChanceTableID.description: ID of the ChanceTable from StageOperations.ChanceTablesByID. Used ONLY when Type = Chance/Chance1/Chance2/Chance3. null/empty falls back to the "default" key, then (for compatibility) to a single-shot reward from StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Chance"]/["Chance1"]/["Chance2"]/["Chance3"] for the specific variant. Ignored for non-Chance tiles.

CustomTypeID.description: Custom tile ID used ONLY when Type == Custom. Acts as the key for StageOperations.OnTileLanding, LandedTileType in the response, and BoardTileLanding event-token source filter. Ignored for non-Custom types. Conventionally PascalCase or snake_case; avoid collisions with BoardTileType enum names to keep CMS unambiguous.

Index.description: Tile index in the board ring (0..N-1).

Params.description: Arbitrary string parameters for A/B tests and event extensions (e.g. probability overrides or link to a specific event).

RandomActionAttackWeight.description: Weight of the Attack option in random-action selection for BoardTileType.RandomAction tiles. Used together with RandomActionRaidWeight.

RandomActionRaidWeight.description: Weight of the Raid option in random-action selection for BoardTileType.RandomAction tiles.

SpecialModeID.description: ID of the SpecialModeDefinition from StageOperations.SpecialModesByID. Used ONLY when Type = Special. null/empty falls back to the "default" key; if missing, the Special landing is a no-op (no offer is created). Ignored for non-Special tiles.

Type.description: Tile type that defines the landing mechanic.

x-enum-descriptions: Neutral tile — triggers no mechanic.
Reward tile (base variant) — grants resources per StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Reward"]. Behaviour identical to Reward1/Reward2/Reward3, only the config key differs.
Reward tile variant 1 — grants resources per StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Reward1"]. Behaviour identical to Reward/Reward2/Reward3, only the config key differs.
Reward tile variant 2 — grants resources per StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Reward2"]. Behaviour identical to Reward/Reward1/Reward3, only the config key differs.
Reward tile variant 3 — grants resources per StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Reward3"]. Behaviour identical to Reward/Reward1/Reward2, only the config key differs.

Chance tile (base variant) — resolves via BoardTileDefinition.ChanceTableID, falling back to StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Chance"]. Behaviour identical to Chance1/Chance2/Chance3, only the config key differs.

Chance tile variant 1 — resolves via BoardTileDefinition.ChanceTableID, falling back to StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Chance1"]. Behaviour identical to Chance/Chance2/Chance3, only the config key differs.

Chance tile variant 2 — resolves via BoardTileDefinition.ChanceTableID, falling back to StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Chance2"]. Behaviour identical to Chance/Chance1/Chance3, only the config key differs.

Chance tile variant 3 — resolves via BoardTileDefinition.ChanceTableID, falling back to StageOperations.OnTileLanding["Chance3"]. Behaviour identical to Chance/Chance1/Chance2, only the config key differs.
Railroad tile with random action. Weights are RandomActionAttackWeight and RandomActionRaidWeight.
Railroad tile with a forced attack on an opponent building.
Railroad tile with a forced raid on an opponent bank.
Shield pickup tile. Grants ShieldCurrencyID; overflow converts to RollCurrencyID.

Generic event tile. On landing, grants resources from StageOperations.OnTileLanding[EventToken]. Deprecated for new content — any Custom tile can grant event tokens via TriggerSource.TileTypeFilter + TileIndexFilter in TimedEventDefinitions. Kept for compatibility with existing configs.

Custom reward tile extensible via CMS without SDK rebuild. The OnTileLanding key, LandedTileType in the response, and BoardTileLanding event-token filter all use BoardTileDefinition.CustomTypeID instead of the enum name. No system side-effects (behaves like Reward/Reward1/Reward2/Reward3/Chance/Chance1/Chance2/Chance3).

Universal Special tile with flexible config via SpecialModeDefinition. On landing, the player receives an offer with one or more choices (SpecialChoiceMode.Instant grants a small immediate reward; SpecialChoiceMode.Timed starts a duration-based mode with optional ad/RewardedVideoCredit-driven multipliers). The concrete config is resolved by BoardTileDefinition.SpecialModeID from StageOperations.SpecialModesByID.

Cooperative Community Chest tile (board-game-style). On landing, the server makes a free auto-contribution to the player's group shared meter (see CommunityChestDefinition); no pending interaction is created. If StageOperations.OnTileLanding["CommunityChest"] defines a personal reward, it is granted in addition to the contribution. If the player is not in an active group, the contribution is skipped (the tile behaves like a neutral/reward tile).

BuildingDefinition.description: Config of a single building within a stage. Buildings are upgraded from 0 to MaxLevel for soft currency; per-level cost is ceil(Unit(N) * CostMatrix[SlotIndex][level]) (see ProceduralEconomyConfig.CostMatrixTemplatesByID).

AssetPaths.description: Asset paths for the building (key = asset type, value = path). Optional; used by the client to load visual resources.

MaxLevel.description: Maximum building level (inclusive). Required — must be > 0, no default; the resolver/build fail when <= 0. Each level cost is ceil(Unit(N) * CostMatrix[SlotIndex][level]).

MaxLevelReward.description: One-time reward on first reaching MaxLevel. Granted atomically with the final upgrade; not re-granted (BuildingState.MaxLevelRewardClaimed).

Name.description: Building display name (for CMS and UI).

SlotIndex.description: Slot index in the stage's building array (0..4). Matches BuildingState.SlotIndex on the player.

x-enum-descriptions: Nothing — regular landing with ChanceOutcome.Reward grant.
Creates an Attack pending interaction (equivalent to landing on BoardTileType.Attack).
Creates a Raid pending interaction (equivalent to landing on BoardTileType.Raid).

Creates a Special-mode pending interaction (equivalent to landing on BoardTileType.Special). The mode is resolved by priority: ChanceOutcome.SpecialModeID -> BoardTileDefinition.SpecialModeID -> "default" key in StageOperations.SpecialModesByID.

ChanceOutcome.description: A single weighted ChanceTable outcome. May combine Reward (resource grant) and ForceAction (trigger Attack/Raid pending) — both apply: reward is granted atomically with the roll op, pending is created after it.

ForceAction.description: Forced action after applying Reward. None = regular landing. Attack/Raid/Special = create the corresponding pending interaction (as if the tile was Attack/Raid/Special).

OutcomeID.description: Semantic outcome identifier (e.g. "small_coins", "medium_coins", "big_coins", "force_attack"). Used for targeted event-token grants: when this outcome fires, auto-route passes OutcomeID into TriggerSource.ChanceOutcomeFilter. null/empty = outcome is opaque to the filter (tokens follow the general TileTypeFilter rule).

Reward.description: Outcome reward (currencies, shields, items, explicit event tokens). Applied via the standard ApplyScaledOperation pipeline + BoardStageTemplate.TileLandingMultiplier. null = no explicit reward (used for pure ForceAction outcomes).

SpecialModeID.description: Special-mode ID from StageOperations.SpecialModesByID when ForceAction = Special. null/empty falls back to BoardTileDefinition.SpecialModeID of the current tile, then to the "default" key. Ignored for other ForceAction values.

Weight.description: Weight for weighted selection. Must be > 0; otherwise the outcome is skipped.

ChanceTable.description: Weighted outcome table for BoardTileType.Chance/Chance1/Chance2/Chance3 tiles. On landing, the server performs one weighted roll over Outcomes and applies the selected ChanceOutcome (reward grant, forced Attack/Raid, auto-routed event tokens).

Outcomes.description: Weighted list of outcomes. Entries with Weight <= 0 are skipped. If all weights are zero or the list is empty, the Chance landing is treated as neutral (no effect).

x-enum-descriptions: Platform was not reported, or the reported one contradicts the request fingerprint.
Browser: web build, WebGL, or a messenger mini-app.
Android build (Google Play Billing).
iOS / iPadOS build (App Store, StoreKit).

CommunityChestDefinition.description: Cooperative Community Chest config. One shared meter per group, milestone rewards plus a final Grand Prize. Self-contained round schedule (anchor + duration + pause), independent of chains.

AnchorUtc.description: Anchor point (UTC). The first round starts here; all later dates are computed automatically. null = no anchor -> no rounds run.

ContributionMax.description: Maximum contribution per landing. Actual value is uniform in [Min; Max].

ContributionMin.description: Minimum contribution per landing on the chest tile.

GrandPrize.description: Grand Prize — granted to every member when the meter is filled to 100% (Status=Completed).

IsActive.description: Whether the feature is active. false = no new groups are created and tile contribution is skipped.

MatchmakingTimeoutMinutes.description: Partner matchmaking timeout (minutes). Unfilled slots are taken by bots afterwards.

MaxProgress.description: Maximum of the shared meter (100%). If <= 0, the largest Milestones[].RequiredProgress is used.

MemberGracePeriodMinutes.description: Grace period when a member leaves (minutes).

Milestones.description: Milestones on the shared meter (unified MilestoneDefinition, Core/Milestone). Key = MilestoneID. When the threshold is reached, each member may claim the reward. Threshold is checked against shared group progress (not EventToken).

PartnerCount.description: Number of partners (excluding the initiator). Group size = 1 + PartnerCount.

PauseBetweenRoundsSec.description: Pause between rounds (seconds). No new groups are created during the pause.

RoundDurationSec.description: Duration of a single chest round in seconds.

ScaleContributionWithRollMultiplier.description: If true, the contribution is multiplied by the used roll multiplier (usedMultiplier).

EventTokenAddress.description: Universal event-token address. Uniquely identifies the system and event the tokens belong to.

EntityID.description: Event identifier within the system. In TITLE CONFIG (rewards written by a designer or an AI agent) scheduled systems use the SHORT form — the cycle number is unknowable at config time: "{TimedEventID}" / "{LeaderboardID}" = whichever instance is active at grant time, or "{ID}:{ChainedEventID}" = that chain phase in the current cycle. The engine (EventTokenAddressResolver in ResourceService) expands it before granting; a grant with no active instance is dropped. At RUNTIME the bucket address is always the full form "{EntityID}:{InstanceKey}": TimedEvent Scheduled → "{TimedEventID}:s{yyyyMMddHHmm}"; TimedEvent Chain → "{chainID}:{cycleIndex}:{chainedEventID}"; Leaderboard → "{leaderboardID}:{instanceKey}"; CoopEvent → CoopChainID; Season → SeasonChainID.

EventTokenOperation.description: Information about granted event tokens. Returned in Board_Roll, QuestComplete and other responses. All multipliers (Roll/Premium/BonusWindow/ProgressiveTier/SeasonBuffs) are applied via ModifierService before ResourceService; this carries the final amount. Use ModifierApplyResult alongside ResourceOperation if UI needs multiplier breakdown.

Address.description: Event token address — where to grant or consume.

Amount.description: Token amount — how many to grant or consume.

Source.description: Operation source (sourceKey used for analytics and limits).

HeistGridBonusConfig.description: Raid grid generation config for a stage (Bank Heist). Two-level random: per-raid variant selection by weight, then per-cell bonus selection from BonusPool. Variants may also have GuaranteedBonus, independent of opened cells.

Variants.description: Weighted variants. One is picked at random per raid. Empty list equals null on the config (all raids are classic). Negative/zero weights are ignored.

HeistRaidVariant.description: A single raid variant. Describes bonus density, bonus pool, guaranteed reward and jackpot parameters.

BonusPool.description: Weighted bonus pool. One bonus is independently selected for each bonus cell. An empty pool with Min/Max > 0 is a config error (cells stay plain).

GuaranteedBonus.description: Guaranteed reward granted to the attacker ONCE at the raid final (any RaidOutcome), independent of which cells the player opened. null = no guaranteed reward (standard for the classic variant). Scales by ScaledResourceOperation.ScaleWithRollMultiplier.

IsJackpot.description: true = jackpot raid variant (board-game-style). Final RaidOutcome is forced to Jackpot regardless of symbols; JackpotFinalMultiplier is applied on top of the heist multiplier; layout follows JackpotSymbolDistribution if set, else 4/4/4. false = regular variant.

JackpotFinalMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the ENTIRE stolen bank in jackpot mode, ON TOP of the regular heist multiplier (x1/x2/x5). final = baseRaidReward * rollMultiplier * heistMultiplier * JackpotFinalMultiplier. Ignored when IsJackpot = false. 0 or negative is treated as 1.0.

JackpotSymbolDistribution.description: Override of the symbol distribution for a jackpot variant's layout. Key = HeistSymbol name as string ("Small", "Medium", "Big"), value = number of cells of that symbol. The sum must be 12, else generation falls back to default 4/4/4. Example: {"Big":6, "Medium":3, "Small":3}. null = default. Only used when IsJackpot = true.

MaxBonusCells.description: Maximum number of bonus cells (0..12). Must be >= MinBonusCells. Actual count is uniform in [Min, Max].

MinBonusCells.description: Minimum number of bonus cells in this variant (0..12). 0 for the classic variant.

Tag.description: Variant tag for analytics, UI banners and logging ("classic", "small_bonus", "big_bonus", "jackpot"). Propagated to BoardPendingInteraction.HeistVariantTag when the raid is created.

Weight.description: Weight for weighted selection from HeistGridBonusConfig.Variants. Must be > 0; otherwise the variant is skipped.

MilestoneDefinition.description: Unified milestone primitive for all platform systems (TimedEvent, Leaderboard, Quest, CommunityChest, DealOffer). Replaces the per-module milestone definitions. Threshold is checked against accumulated progress (RequiredProgress): EventToken systems use EventTokenBalanceData.TotalEarned; CommunityChest uses shared group progress. Reward overlays BonusRewards (bonus-window) and SeasonTierRewards (season-tier) are platform-wide optional fields applied via MilestoneRewardResolver; leave null if unused.

BonusRewards.description: Bonus-window overlay: extra rewards on top of Rewards when the bonus phase is active at claim time (MilestoneRewardContext.BonusActive). Applied via MilestoneRewardResolver. null = no bonus part.

DisplayName.description: Display name for UI/CMS. null = unset.

IsFeatured.description: Featured milestone: special UI styling. With MilestoneClaimMode.FeaturedAfterEnd these can only be claimed after the instance ends.

MilestoneID.description: Unique milestone ID within its owning entity (Mongo-safe, claim idempotency key).

RequiredProgress.description: Threshold over ACCUMULATED progress to unlock. EventToken systems: EventTokenBalanceData.TotalEarned (not current balance). CommunityChest: shared group progress.

Rewards.description: Base rewards. Always granted on a successful claim.

SeasonTierRewards.description: Season-tier overlay: reward scaling by the player's season tier. Applied via MilestoneRewardResolver (SeasonTierRewardResolver.Resolve) only when MilestoneRewardContext.SeasonChainID is set. null = disabled.

SortOrder.description: Sort order in the UI (lower = higher/earlier).

PremiumTierBonus.description: Percentage bonus on ResourceGrant.Standard for a premium tier. All Standard Amounts are multiplied by (1 + Bonus) with Math.Ceiling rounding. Applies only to Standard; in Replace mode the bonused Standard is wiped when any PremiumTier matches. Best matching tier wins, bonuses do not stack. Symmetric to PremiumTierDiscount.

Bonus.description: Bonus as a SHARE: 0.1 = +10%, 1.0 = double (x2). Empty or 0 = no bonus. The unit is the same across the whole platform — never a 0..100 percent.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PremiumTierBundle.description: Per-tier bundle describing a structurally different set of resources (different ItemIDs/tokens/currencies) available only to subscribers. Used in both ResourceGrant.PremiumTiers (rewards) and ResourceConsume.PremiumTiers (price). Differs from PremiumTierBonus/PremiumTierDiscount which only modify Standard Amounts by percentage.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

Resources.description: Items, currencies and tokens of this tier. Entries with Amount=0 are valid and mean 'skip'. Empty/null Resources in Consume.PremiumTiers means 'premium pays nothing' (equivalent to Discounts: 1.0).

PremiumTierDiscount.description: Percentage discount on ResourceConsume.Standard for a premium tier. All Standard Amounts are multiplied by (1 - Discount) with Math.Ceiling rounding in player's favor. Applies only to Standard; ignored if PremiumTiers matches. Best matching tier wins, discounts do not stack. Symmetric to PremiumTierBonus.

Discount.description: Discount as a SHARE: 0.1 = -10%, 1.0 = free. Empty or 0 = no discount. The unit is the same across the whole platform — never a 0..100 percent.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PriceOption.description: A single way to pay for an entity. Platform-wide standard: everything with a configured price describes it as a PriceOptions dictionary whose key is the OptionID. Options exist because ResourceConsume.Standard is charged as a whole (AND), while a price across platforms is a choice (OR): a store SKU on mobile, a token on web. Platform duties split as "the client renders, the server allows": title config ships as one immutable artifact per (version, field set), so it cannot be filtered per request — the client hides options by AllowedPlatforms, while PriceOptionSelector.Select refuses a charge whose option is not available on the caller's platform.

AllowedPlatforms.description: Platforms this option is available on. Empty/null = all of them. Do not list Unknown: a client that did not report its platform only gets options with no platform restriction, i.e. those safe everywhere.

AssetPaths.description: Option assets (currency icon, discount badge). Key = asset slug.

Cost.description: What is charged for this option. Standard is the base; PremiumDiscounts / PremiumTiers behave as everywhere else. An entry of type Purchase means the option is paid in a store rather than with a player resource: the payment is verified before ResourceService and never enters the resource operation. No initializer on purpose — "unset" must differ from "set to empty"; an unset Cost means the option is free.

Name.description: Display name of the option ("For gold", "$0.99"). A localization key or a literal — resolved client-side by the rule own table → fallback table → the key itself.

OptionID.description: Payment-option identifier. If empty, the dictionary key is substituted (PriceOptionResolver) — the client selects an option by this ID, so an option without one would be unselectable.

ProceduralEconomyConfig.description: Global procedural-economy parameters for the board. Any value may be overridden per-stage via BoardStageTemplate.EconomyOverride; these are the defaults.

AttackBlockedRewardFactor.description: Attack reward multiplier when blocked by a shield (0 = no reward on block). Configured per title (no default).

AttackValueFromCostMatrix.description: Whether to weight the attack payout by the value of the building hit (CostMatrix[slot][hitLevel-1]). When false, the attack pays a flat base.

CostMatrixTemplatesByID.description: Named normalized cost matrices (B1-L1 = 1.0). Key = PascalCase template ID ("Universal" = MGO default; "WideSpread" = e.g. board 9). A stage picks one via BoardStageDefinition.CostMatrixTemplateID. Level cost = ceil(Unit(N) * matrix[slot][level]). Non-separable -> stored whole. Required key "Universal" (matched case-insensitively).

DifficultyGrowthPerBoard.description: Geometric growth of board DIFFICULTY: how many times longer each next board takes on the same price curve. Divides EconomyScale(N) by G^(N-1), so income grows SLOWER than cost and rolls-per-board follow rolls(1) * G^(N-1) regardless of how irregular the UnitValue anchors are. Unlike the per-stage EconomyScale override this also covers synthesized endless boards, which have no Override at all. null or 1.0 = previous behaviour (constant pace); non-positive/NaN/Infinity are ignored.

EconomyScaledResources.description: Set of resources (currencies and/or items) scaled by EconomyScale(N) — a unified ResourceBundle (currencies/items in Entries, matched by category Item/currency + ID, case-insensitive). Amount is ignored — this is a selector, not a grant. null/empty = nothing is scaled.

PerBoardGrowth.description: Tail geometric growth of the unit price Unit(N) past the last authored anchor (extrapolation), e.g. 1.0035 (~ +0.35% per board). Required — must be set (> 0), no default.

ScaleAttackRewardWithEconomy.description: Whether to scale the attack reward by EconomyScale of the attacker's board.

ScaleRaidStealWithEconomy.description: Whether to scale the attacker's systemic raid gain by EconomyScale of their board.

ScaleVictimLossWithEconomy.description: Whether to scale the victim's intended loss by EconomyScale of the victim's board (before balance clipping).

ScaleVictimLossWithTier.description: Whether to apply the heist tier (x1/x2/x5) to the victim's loss.

SynthesizedBuildingMaxLevel.description: Building MaxLevel for synthesized endless boards. Required for endless boards — must be set (> 0), no default.

SynthesizedBuildingSlots.description: Number of building slots for synthesized endless boards (beyond authored content). Required for endless boards — must be set (> 0), no default.

VisualTemplateCycle.description: Visual-template cycle (BoardStageDefinition.BoardTemplateID) for synthesized endless boards: board N uses cycle[(N-1) % cycle.Count]. Empty - synthesis falls back to the first available template.

x-enum-descriptions: New mode. Client receives the full RaidLayout and submits all opened indices in a single request (BoardLoopRaidFast). Reduces latency and round-trips.
Classic mode. Layout is not exposed; each cell is opened via a separate request (BoardLoopRaid). Server validates every step.

ResourceBundle.description: Set of items, currencies and tokens for a single operation direction (grant only or consume only).

ResourceConsume.description: Consume direction container for ResourceOperation. Two mutually exclusive premium mechanisms over Standard: PremiumTiers (priority) replaces Standard with the best matching tier's Resources via Replace, and PremiumDiscounts (fallback) applies a percentage discount to Standard only when no PremiumTier matched. Best matching tier wins, no stacking.

PremiumDiscounts.description: Percentage discount on Standard for premium players. Single best matching tier wins (no stacking): Amount = ceil(Amount * (1 - Discount)). Ignored if any PremiumTier matched — Replace takes over.

PremiumTiers.description: Structurally different price for premium players (different ItemID/CurrencyID/Target). Always Replace, single best matching tier wins. If matched, Standard is fully replaced and PremiumDiscounts is ignored; otherwise fallback to Standard + PremiumDiscounts.

Standard.description: Base — what to charge all players including F2P.

ResourceEntry.description: Universal container for a single entry in a resource bundle (item or currency). The set of populated fields depends on Type: Item uses CatalogID/ItemID/Amount; VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency uses CurrencyID/Amount; Purchase uses only ProductID (paid in a store).

Amount.description: Amount of the resource. Used by every type except Purchase, where the quantity is decided by the store itself and this field is ignored. Amount=0 is valid in Consume.PremiumTiers and means 'do not charge'.

AmountUsd.description: CryptoCurrency only: the amount in USD instead of a token count. At the moment of the operation the engine converts it to tokens at the LIVE market price of the token (charge: rounded up to a whole token; grant: rounded down). When set, Amount is ignored; the operation result carries the converted Amount.

CatalogID.description: Item catalog identifier. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs (e.g. "main", "season").

CurrencyID.description: Currency identifier. Used only when Type is VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies or cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

ItemID.description: Item identifier within the catalog. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs[Catalog].Items.

ProductID.description: IAP product identifier. Used only when Type is Purchase. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Purchase.Products — OUR stable product ID, not the store SKU (per-store SKUs live in IapProductDefinition.StoreProductIDs).

Type.description: Resource type. Determines which fields must be populated: Item (catalog item), VirtualCurrency (off-chain), CryptoCurrency (on-chain), or Purchase (real-money payment in a store).

x-enum-descriptions: Catalog item. Requires CatalogID, ItemID and Amount.
In-game (off-chain) virtual currency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies.
On-chain cryptocurrency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

Real-money payment in a store. Requires only ProductID (a product from cfg.Purchase.Products); the amount and currency are decided by the store from the SKU price tier. NOT a storable resource and never passes through ResourceService — the money is paid outside before the server learns about it, so the entry is consumed by the receipt check (ExternalPaymentGate) and stripped before the resource operation. Allowed only in Consume and only for Consumable products.

Rewarded-video credit. One credit equals one verified ad view that can be spent in systems requiring rewarded video (lootbox open, reward double, re-roll, booster). Granted +1 per server-verified view, or as N from milestones/quests/premium perks; spent -1 per gated action.

ResourceGrant.description: Grant direction container for ResourceOperation. Two independent premium mechanisms over Standard: PremiumBonuses applies a percentage uplift to Standard (single best tier wins, no stack), and PremiumTiers provides structurally different rewards governed by cfg.Reward.TierRewards (Additive or Replace mode; in Replace the bonused Standard is wiped). Both mechanisms can be used together or independently.

PremiumBonuses.description: Percentage uplift on Standard for premium players. Single best matching tier wins (no stacking): Amount = ceil(Amount * (1 + Bonus)). Wiped under Mode=Replace if any PremiumTier matches.

PremiumTiers.description: Structurally different rewards for premium players (different ItemID/Target/...). Governed by global cfg.Reward.TierRewards.RewardMode (Additive/Replace) and RewardStackLowerTiers.

Standard.description: Base — what to grant to all players including F2P.

ResourceOperation.description: Container for all platform operations: what to grant and what to consume.

Consume.description: Consume direction. null if the operation only grants.

Grant.description: Grant direction. null if the operation only consumes.

RewardMultiplierRange.description: Real-valued multiplier range for reward randomization. On roll, mul is sampled uniformly in [Min, Max]. 1.0..1.0 = neutral (no-op).

Max.description: Upper bound (inclusive). Must be >= Min. Default 1.0. Recommended soft-cap <= 3.0 to avoid runaway stacking with RollMultiplier and ModifierService.

ScaledResourceOperation.description: Wrapper over ResourceOperation that adds a roll-multiplier scaling flag. Used in all StageOperations hooks for the uniform P_total = P_base * M_roll formula.

ScaleWithRollMultiplier.description: true: all Amount values in the operation are multiplied by the current RollMultiplier before application (P_total = P_base * M_roll). false: Amount is passed to ResourceService unchanged. Typically true for rewards and false for costs.

SeasonTierRewardBundle.description: Structurally different rewards for a season-chain tier. Analogous to PremiumTierBundle but the trigger is the player's season tier. Selection picks the single best match (MinSeasonTier <= playerTier); not stacked.

MinSeasonTier.description: Minimum player season tier required for this bundle to apply. Matches SeasonTierDefinition.Tier / UserSeasonState.CurrentTier.

Rewards.description: Rewards for this tier. Passed unmodified into ResourceService via a regular ResourceOperation.Grant.

SeasonChainID.description: SeasonChainID this tier is linked to. Selection matches only tiers with the same SeasonChainID.

SeasonTierRewardMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to Amount of the base ResourceGrant for a season-chain tier. Applied to every ResourceEntry.Amount and EventTokenOperation.Amount in Standard and in PremiumTiers.Resources.

MinSeasonTier.description: Minimum player season tier required for this multiplier to apply.

Multiplier.description: Multiplier. 1.0 = neutral (resolver returns the base reward without copying). Rounding: (long)Math.Round(Amount * Multiplier). Entries with final Amount <= 0 are dropped.

SeasonChainID.description: SeasonChainID this tier is linked to.

SeasonTierRewardSet.description: Generic container of season-tier reward scaling. Used by any platform system (leaderboards, lootboxes, shop, daily) that wants to scale a ResourceGrant by the player's current tier in a season chain. Empty/null lists = neutral.

Bundles.description: Structurally different rewards for specific tiers. On match, replaces the base ResourceGrant entirely (Replace).

Multipliers.description: Multipliers applied to Amount of the base ResourceGrant. Used ONLY if no Bundles entry matched.

x-enum-descriptions: Instant reward — granted at Choose, pending is cleared.
Timer of SpecialModeChoice.DurationSeconds with a final Claim.

SpecialClaimMultipliers.description: Claim-multiplier rules for the Timed flow. One Board_SpecialApplyMultiplier rolls rolled in [PerAdMultiplierRange.Min, .Max], spends AdCreditCost RewardedVideoCredits and accumulates into pending state per FormulaKind.

AdCreditCost.description: How many RewardedVideoCredit units are spent per Apply. Default 1.

ApplyMultiplierOnEarlyClaim.description: Whether to apply the AccumulatedMultiplier to the EarlyClaim reward — claiming BEFORE the first gradation tier (BelowFirstTierReward). On any REACHED tier the multiplier is always applied regardless of this flag. false (default) = no multiplier when claiming before the first tier; the ad views already spent are forfeited (board-game-style retention incentive). true = the multiplier is also applied to the EarlyClaim reward (fairer to the player, lower retention pressure).

FormulaKind.description: How rolled values accumulate. Additive: rolled is added to AccumulatedMultiplier (start 0.0), final = Reward × (1 + AccumulatedMultiplier). Multiplicative: rolled is multiplied (start 1.0), final = Reward × AccumulatedMultiplier.

MaxAdViews.description: Maximum Apply calls (ad views / credit spends) per Timed flow. The server additionally clamps with an absolute ceiling of 10 — defence against malformed config.

PerAdMultiplierRange.description: Random multiplier range per single Apply (reuses RewardMultiplierRange). Min == Max = deterministic. For Additive, values 0..N represent the increment (neutral 0 = x1.0). For Multiplicative, values 1..N represent the multiplier itself.

SpecialGradationConfig.description: Time-based reward ladder for a Timed Special choice: the longer the player waits before claiming, the higher the tier. Independent from SpecialRunStatsConfig - the two axes are summed.

BelowFirstTierReward.description: Optional reward when claiming BEFORE the first tier (elapsed < Tiers[0].ElapsedSeconds). null = reject the early claim (Fail "Play window not closed yet").

TierMode.description: How reached time tiers pay out. Default Highest - only the highest reached tier pays (the behaviour before this field existed). Cumulative - every reached tier pays and the rewards are summed.

Tiers.description: Time-ranked reward tiers (sorted ascending by ElapsedSeconds at Choose). Which of the reached tiers pay out is decided by TierMode.

SpecialGradationTier.description: One gradation tier of a Timed Special choice: reward unlocked once ElapsedSeconds have passed since StartedAtUtc.

ElapsedSeconds.description: Elapsed seconds since StartedAtUtc at which this tier's reward becomes the active claimable reward. Must be > 0. Tiers ranked ascending at Choose.

Reward.description: Reward for reaching this tier. Snapshotted (scaled) at Choose. Supports ScaledResourceOperation.ScaleWithRollMultiplier.

ChoiceID.description: Identifier of the choice, unique within the SpecialModeDefinition (e.g. "instant_small", "play_5min"). Sent by the client to Board_SpecialChoose to commit the selection.

DurationSeconds.description: Timed-flow duration in seconds. Ignored for Instant.

Gradation.description: Time-based reward ladder for the Timed flow. The reward at Claim is picked from the tiers whose ElapsedSeconds have passed since entering the mode. Ignored for Instant. Optional, like RunStats - what IS required is that a Timed choice has AT LEAST ONE reward axis; a choice with neither is rejected at Choose.

Mode.description: Choice type. Instant grants the reward immediately on Choose. Timed starts a DurationSeconds timer; the player can apply multipliers and claims the final reward via Board_SpecialClaim.

Multipliers.description: Multiplier config for the Timed flow (random range, view cap, formula). null = Timed without multipliers (player just waits Duration and claims the base). Ignored for Instant.

PriceOptions.description: Optional ways to pay for entering, charged atomically at Choose (e.g., a monetisation gate). Dictionary key = PriceOption.OptionID. null/empty = free.

Reward.description: Choice reward for Instant — granted directly at Choose. Ignored for Timed: the Timed reward is fully defined by the Gradation ladder. Supports ScaledResourceOperation.ScaleWithRollMultiplier.

RunStats.description: Rewards for the run's gameplay statistics (coins, experience, enemies killed...) - a SECOND reward axis on top of Gradation, not a replacement. The client reports measured values in GameLoopRequest.RunStats together with Board_SpecialClaim. null = feature off, Claim pays by time only. Ignored for Instant.

SpecialModeDefinition.description: Special-mode configuration. Bound to a tile via BoardTileDefinition.SpecialModeID. Holds a set of Choices the player picks from after landing.

Choices.description: Choices shown to the player on landing. Typically 1–3 variants; empty list = no-op landing.

ClaimExpireSeconds.description: Seconds from StartedAtUtc to auto-expiry for the Timed flow. Must be >= max SpecialModeChoice.DurationSeconds + grace, otherwise the claim window closes before the player can claim. Required when the mode is used — must be set (> 0), no default.

OfferExpireSeconds.description: How many seconds the offer remains awaitable for Choose. If the player doesn't choose, the pending expires. Required when the mode is used — must be set (> 0), no default.

x-enum-descriptions: Sum: AccumulatedMultiplier += rolled (neutral 0.0).
Product: AccumulatedMultiplier *= rolled (neutral 1.0).

SpecialRunStatsConfig.description: Run-statistics reward ladders for a Timed Special choice - a second, independent reward axis on top of the time-based Gradation ladder. The client reports measured run values in GameLoopRequest.RunStats ({MetricID: value}) together with Board_SpecialClaim; the server validates them against this whitelist and adds the reached tiers' rewards to the time-tier reward. null/empty = feature off, Claim behaves as before.

MetricsByID.description: Whitelist of metrics. Key = MetricID (e.g. "enemies_killed", "survived_seconds"). A metric absent from this dictionary is ignored by the server - the client cannot introduce a new metric.

SpecialStatMetricConfig.description: A single run metric: its cap, tier payout mode and the threshold ladder itself. Nullable fields have no initializers (preset-merge rule: unset = from preset, set = final, including zero) - read them via SpecialDefinitionDefaults.Effective*.

ApplyClaimMultiplier.description: Whether this metric's reward is multiplied by the Claim's accumulated ad multiplier (SpecialClaimResponse.FinalMultiplier). Default false, deliberately: the multiplier is the price of ads applied to the TIME axis, while run statistics is a second, independent axis. Turning it on yields tier x statistics x ads on a single claim - three multipliers at once. Enable only if the economy budget can absorb it.

MaxValuePerClaim.description: Cap on the accepted value per Claim. Anything above is CLAMPED (not rejected, not a ban): the reward is computed as if at the cap, and the fact is recorded in SpecialModeStats.StatReportsClampedCount and SpecialClaimResponse.RunStatsClamped. Default 0 = no cap. Set it from what is actually achievable within DurationSeconds, not from a round number.

MetricID.description: Metric ID. Normally equals the key in SpecialRunStatsConfig.MetricsByID; when unset the server substitutes the dictionary key.

Rate.description: LINEAR payout: the reward is proportional to the metric value itself, with no tiers. This is how "you collected N coins in the run, you get N" is expressed. Independent from Tiers and summed with it. Both unset = the metric pays nothing.

TierMode.description: How reached tiers pay out. Default Highest - same as the time ladder: only the highest reached tier pays.

Tiers.description: Threshold ladder for the metric. Sorted and deduplicated by RequiredValue at Choose. An empty ladder means the metric pays nothing by tiers - unlike the time ladder this is NOT an error - but it may still pay linearly via Rate.

SpecialStatRateConfig.description: Linear payout for a metric: units = value / MetricPerReward (floored), clamped by MaxRewardUnits, and Reward is multiplied by that count. Note there are TWO caps doing different jobs: MaxValuePerClaim is anti-cheat (what we will believe from the client), MaxRewardUnits is budget (what we are willing to pay). At a 1:1 rate they coincide.

MaxRewardUnits.description: Cap on the number of reward units - the most we are willing to pay for this metric. Default 0 = no cap. At a one-to-one rate this reads directly as "no more than N units of currency".

MetricPerReward.description: How many metric units make up one reward unit. Default 1 - one-to-one payout. 10 means "one reward per 10 units"; the remainder is dropped (units are floored). Zero and negative are treated as 1.

Reward.description: Reward for ONE unit of the metric. Usually "1 coin": the player then gets 1347 for 1347 collected. Supports ScaledResourceOperation.ScaleWithRollMultiplier.

SpecialStatTier.description: One tier of a metric ladder: the reward unlocks once the run's metric value reaches RequiredValue.

RequiredValue.description: Metric threshold. Must be > 0 and finite, otherwise the tier is dropped at Choose. Fractional ON PURPOSE: run metrics are inherently fractional (time in seconds, experience), and "survive 90.5 seconds" cannot be expressed on an integer type. The server compares with a relative epsilon, so 90.49999999997 does satisfy a 90.5 threshold - otherwise float noise would cost the player the tier. The REWARD itself stays integral: it is rounded by the platform's single rounding point, AmountMath.

Reward.description: Reward for reaching this tier. Snapshotted (scaled) at Choose. Supports ScaledResourceOperation.ScaleWithRollMultiplier.

x-enum-descriptions: Only the HIGHEST reached tier pays - same as the time ladder.
ALL reached tiers pay (rewards are summed).

StageEconomyOverride.description: Container of per-stage procedural-economy overrides. Symmetric to the global ProceduralEconomyConfig. All fields nullable: null = "not set here, use the global value". Matrix and lists are replaced wholesale (no element-wise merge).

CostMatrix.description: Last-resort inline cost-matrix override for this stage. Normal path is a named template via BoardStageDefinition.CostMatrixTemplateID; set this only for a fully unique board. Resolve priority: inline override -> template by ID -> "Universal". null = use the template.

EconomyScale.description: Manual override of the resolved EconomyScale(N) for the stage. null = computed from anchors (Unit(N) / Unit(1)).

PerBoardGrowth.description: Override of the Unit(N) tail growth (used when this stage is the last authored anchor that extrapolation runs from). null = global ProceduralEconomyConfig.PerBoardGrowth.

ScaledResources.description: Scaled-resource set for the stage (ResourceBundle). Replaces ProceduralEconomyConfig.EconomyScaledResources. null = global set.

StageOperations.description: Server-configured resource operations for all in-stage game events. Each field is a ScaledResourceOperation containing a ResourceOperation (grant/consume) plus the roll-multiplier scaling flag.

ChanceTablesByID.description: Outcome tables for BoardTileType.Chance/Chance1/Chance2/Chance3 tiles. Key = arbitrary table ID (e.g. "default", "big_chance"). A tile picks one via BoardTileDefinition.ChanceTableID; missing/unknown ID falls back to "default", then to OnTileLanding["Chance"]/["Chance1"]/["Chance2"]/["Chance3"] for the specific variant (backward compat). Each outcome is a weighted ChanceOutcome: can grant a Reward, force Attack/Raid (ForceAction), and/or scale auto-routed event-token amount (EventTokenMultiplier).

OnAttack.description: Operations per attack outcome. Keys are AttackOutcome names as string ("Hit", "Blocked"). Granted to the attacker in addition to BoardStageTemplate.BaseAttackReward. Typically used to award tournament event tokens.

OnAttackBonusDrops.description: Pool of independent probabilistic bonus drops on attack. Each element is rolled separately. Applied ON TOP of BaseAttackReward and OnAttack. Typical: 5% chance to grant +N milestone-event tokens on Hit.

OnBuild.description: Operation for any building upgrade or repair (Board_Build). ScaleWithRollMultiplier is typically false (build cost does not scale with rolls).

OnPassStart.description: Operation on passing the start tile (GO). Applied per completed lap (lapsDelta times). ScaleWithRollMultiplier is typically true.

OnRaid.description: Operations per raid outcome. Keys are RaidOutcome names as string ("Small", "Medium", "Big", "Jackpot"). Granted to the attacker in addition to the stolen portion of BoardStageTemplate.BaseRaidReward.

OnStageComplete.description: Operation on stage completion (all buildings at max level, none damaged). Granted once at the moment of the final successful build that closes the stage.

OnTileLanding.description: Operations on landing on a specific tile type. For system types the key is BoardTileType name as string ("Reward"/"Reward1"/"Reward2"/"Reward3", "Chance"/"Chance1"/"Chance2"/"Chance3", "EventToken", ...). For tiles with Type == Custom the key is BoardTileDefinition.CustomTypeID (e.g. "Halloween_Pumpkin"). Missing key = no resources for that tile. ScaleWithRollMultiplier is typically true.

SpecialModesByID.description: Special-mode configurations for BoardTileType.Special tiles. Key = arbitrary mode ID (e.g. "default", "boss_arena"). A tile picks one via BoardTileDefinition.SpecialModeID; missing/unknown ID falls back to "default". If neither exists, the Special landing is a no-op (no offer is created).

WeightedHeistCellBonus.description: A single weighted bonus variant for HeistRaidVariant.BonusPool. The bonus is stored as a ScaledResourceOperation to share the multiplier-scaling pipeline and support premium fields inside Bonus.Operation.Grant.

Bonus.description: Bonus payload. Only Bonus.Operation.Grant is used — Consume is ignored here (a cell bonus cannot be a cost). ScaleWithRollMultiplier: true scales Amount by RollMultiplier at cell generation; false = fixed reward.

Tag.description: Analytics/UI tag ("small_token_bag", "big_token_bag", "shield_drop"). Propagated to HeistCell.BonusTag at generation time.

Weight.description: Weight for weighted selection. Must be > 0.

value.description: Root config of the Core Loop system in TitlePublicConfigurationModel.GameLoop. Holds the nested board configuration.

Board.description: Base game board config (dice rolls, tiles, buildings, attacks, raids).

CommunityChest.description: Cooperative Community Chest config (board-game-style). A group of players fills one shared progress meter; contribution comes from landing on the BoardTileType.CommunityChest tile. null / IsActive=false disables the feature.
